description: Stop everything in the workspace from publishing until resumed. Nothing is lost; scheduled posts wait. Resuming (automation_resume, or undo of this) needs the publish permission; without it, a person presses Resume in the app.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: automation_pause
title: Pause publishing
